title: How to Edit the /home URL of the Domain
text:
## How to Edit the /home URL of the Domain
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100077
By default the Homepage of the site is www.yourdomain123.com /home
However, depending on the site verbiage or language, this may need to be changed. There is an advanced setting that will allow the / home portion of the URL to be updated.

## Advanced Settings
Website Homepage URL System Variable: default_home_url
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164647802/original/R1jfYNPjr_OglhKrIl-3AxSqbhW-4JnuuQ.png?1753162566 | alt: ]
Add the text into the field, save the changes, and the URL is immediately updated without needing to reset anything.
